title: Well-posedness and asymptotic limits for a degenerate Keller-Segel system with volume filling
summary: A class of parabolic-parabolic Keller-Segel systems with degenerate diffusion and volume filling is studied in a bounded domain subject to no-flux boundary conditions. The equations are derived from a multiphase fluid model. The interplay between nonlinear diffusion and density saturation leads to a rich variety of behaviors across different parameter regimes.
